name: ModifyStorageStrategy

parameters.help_en: Backup plan ID. Obtain this parameter's value by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html API
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en:
Backup data retention period, in days. Valid values: 0 to 1825.

Default value: 730 days
parameters.help_zh:
备份数据保留时间，单位为天，取值：0~1825。

默认为730（天）
parameters.name: backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
Time to convert to Infrequent Access storage. This value must be less than the Archive Storage period (DuplicationArchivePeriod parameter). For more information about Infrequent Access storage, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/51374.html.

Default value: 180 days
parameters.help_zh:
转为低频访问存储时间。需要小于归档冷备存储时间（DuplicationArchivePeriod参数）。更多关于低频访问存储的说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/51374.html。
默认为180（天）
parameters.name: duplication_infrequent_access_period

parameters.help_en:
Time to convert to Archive Storage. This value must be less than the backup data retention period (BackupRetentionPeriod parameter). For more information about Archive Storage, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/51374.html.

Default value: 365 days
parameters.help_zh:
转为归档冷备存储时间。需要小于备份数据保留时间（BackupRetentionPeriod参数）。更多关于归档存储的说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/51374.html。
默认为365（天）
